comment: Determinism pin for forceLayout() on the default view (docs/idea/17-loop-split-refactor-graph.md §3). sha256 over [id,x,y,rank] per node + width/height — whole-px coordinates since 2026-08-18 (raw floats are ISA-bound: arm64 and x86_64 V8 disagree by ≤2.1e-06 px, so this pin was verified identical on macOS arm64, linux/arm64 and linux/amd64 before freezing). Lives OUTSIDE the test file because tests/anatomy/test_a_fixture_is_never_a_real_secret.py refuses credential-shaped literals inside *.test.ts, and a 64-hex pin is exactly that shape. Re-pin deliberately: run graphLayout.test.ts, read the new hash from the failure — and remember the 6b960b47 lesson: any commit that touches anatomy-graph.json must re-freeze this pin.
